steps.text: We'll be friends from now on. Those adults won't be able to bully us anymore!
Don't be afraid. From now on, I'll help you no matter what happens.
If something bad happens to me, you'd better help me too! That's what friends are for!
Hehe, we'll always be together, right?
Do you still remember what you did when that old duke snatched her away?
Can you really do whatever it takes for the sake of Lungmen?
Now, Wei Yenwu, what - or who - are you going to sacrifice this time?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nngh... Ugh...
Hey, wake up!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Save her...
Officer Ch'en, wake up!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Let me through! Let me...
Puk gaai, I don't have time to deal with this right now!
*splash*—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hnnf!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...
Finally awake?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ack...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, hurry! Reunion—
Are you done daydreaming? Good grief, you're a mess.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Why are you here? Where's my squad?
What if I told you that they were all killed in action?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you're itching for a beating, then you'd better queue up behind Reunion.
I see your tongue is as sharp as ever. How come your performance in battle doesn't follow suit?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's going on over here? I leave for a moment, and you two are already at each others' throats?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Miss Swire, would it kill you to be a little less sarcastic towards her?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You too, Ch'en, you only just woke up...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Wait, why do you look like you just got into a fight with a watering cart?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ask her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Young lady, what's this empty glass doing here? I remember pouring a glass of water for each of you.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: She was spouting nonsense in her sleep.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Good grief...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where are we?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: In a cabin in Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Officer Ch'en, you and your team retreated to Lungmen about 45 minutes ago.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You might've thought that you hid your tracks well, but Reunion did not think that was the case.
